body.x: LG(www.lgcorp.com) had an address up-to-date products at 'Press Conference' of '2014 International CES', the biggest IT∙appliances show that is being held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.

LG unveiled some of its new technologies on CES 2014′s “Press Day.” There are 'ULTRA HDTV lineup', which features a massive 105-inch screen with a 21:9 aspect ratio and 5120 x 2160 5K resolution, and LG 'Homechat', which is a way to communicate with your devices. LG demonstrated its new 'G Flex' 6-inch smart phone, and Fitness Tech, such as 'Lifeband Touch' and 'Heart Rate Earphones'. In addition, many home appliances, such as, audios, washing machines, and refrigerators were introduced by the speakers.

Some outstanding speakers appeared onstage at the CES LG Press Conference. Home Appliances LG Electronics USA, Dave Vanderwaal stressed new refrigerators and washing machines' features by operating and introducing the objects. Mobile communications LG Electronics USA, Frank Lee explained the details of 'LG G Flex' with natural and dynamic gestures that amazingly drew attentions from the audiences.

'CES(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500 ~ 3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
